title: Three Datatype Defining Rewrite Systems for Datatypes of Integers Each Extending a Datatype of Naturals
notes: Provides later context for digit-append and digit-tree arithmetic TRSs and explicitly summarizes CMR97's balanced-ternary append semantics x :_t a = 3x+a and its termination/confluence modulo AC. Used as a corroborating comparison source, not as a substitute for citing CMR97.
